project.name: analyze
project.description: Django-style loan management app with repository/service layers, views, forms, migrations and HTML templates.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the top-level src package.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the core package.

nodes.name: database.py
nodes.summary: Provides a database connectivity probe that runs SELECT 1 through the Django connection.

nodes.name: database_probe
nodes.summary: Executes SELECT 1 on the default Django connection and returns the result to verify DB connectivity.

nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Empty package marker for the loans app.

nodes.name: clock.py
nodes.summary: Defines a system clock adapter returning the current local date via Django timezone utilities.

nodes.name: SystemClock
nodes.summary: Clock implementation that supplies today's localized date to the application service.

nodes.name: composition.py
nodes.summary: Composition root that wires the Django repository and system clock into a singleton LoanApplication.

nodes.name: forms.py
nodes.summary: Django ModelForm exposing the member and isbn fields of Loan for validated input.

nodes.name: LoanForm
nodes.summary: ModelForm over Loan restricted to member and isbn, used by lend endpoints.

nodes.name: models.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM model for a Loan with a computed due date 14 days after lending.

nodes.name: Loan
nodes.summary: Loan record (id, member, isbn, lent_on, returned_on) with a due_on property of lent_on plus 14 days.

nodes.name: repository.py
nodes.summary: Django ORM-backed repository for loans with transactional create and mark-returned operations.

nodes.name: DjangoLoanRepository
nodes.summary: Implements the LoanRepository protocol: list, find, id generation, atomic create, and row-locked mark_returned.

nodes.name: services.py
nodes.summary: Application service layer: defines Protocol ports, the LoanApplication use cases, and CSV-style loan line formatting.

nodes.name: LoanRecord
nodes.summary: Protocol describing the loan fields the service layer relies on.

nodes.name: Clock
nodes.summary: Protocol port for obtaining the current date.

nodes.name: LoanRepository
nodes.summary: Protocol port describing persistence operations required by LoanApplication.

nodes.name: LoanApplication
nodes.summary: Use-case class that lends loans, returns loans, and renders loan text using injected repository and clock.

nodes.name: loan_line
nodes.summary: Formats a loan as a semicolon-delimited CSV line with ISO dates.

nodes.name: urls.py
nodes.summary: URL routing table mapping plain-text API and HTML UI paths to loan views.

nodes.name: views.py
nodes.summary: Django views for the text API and htmx-enabled HTML UI to list, lend, view, and return loans.

nodes.name: loan_catalog
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML list of all loans.

nodes.name: loan_catalog_detail
nodes.summary: Renders the HTML detail page for one loan or 404s.

nodes.name: loan_collection
nodes.summary: Handles GET (plain-text listing) and POST (delegates to loan_lend) on /loans.

nodes.name: loan_lend
nodes.summary: Validates LoanForm and lends a loan, returning 201 text or 400 errors.

nodes.name: loan_lend_page
nodes.summary: HTML lend page handling form display, htmx partials, and redirect after creation.

nodes.name: loan_detail
nodes.summary: Plain-text loan lookup returning 404 if absent.

nodes.name: loan_return
nodes.summary: POST text endpoint returning a loan: 404 if missing, 409 if already returned.

nodes.name: loan_return_page
nodes.summary: HTML/htmx return action rendering status partial or detail page with conflict error.

nodes.name: 0001_initial.py
nodes.summary: Initial Django migration creating the Loan table and seeding three sample loans.

nodes.name: seed_loans
nodes.summary: Data migration that bulk-creates three sample loan records.

nodes.name: Migration
nodes.summary: Creates the Loan model and runs the seed_loans data migration.
